title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated user could create and deliver a crafted…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, an unauthenticated attacker can craft a malicious Investigation Workbench link that, when opened by an authenticated user, executes arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with that user's permissions. This vulnerability arises from improper neutralization of special characters in artifact values. Exploitation requires phishing the user to open the crafted link, as unauthenticated users cannot exploit it directly.
